(well... kind of..) But it's not just that... It is about the battle of rescuing somebody and stopping the Evil and the name of... WinMario -☆-=====================================================Deluxe Pack! --> This is a Special Addon if you want more cool shit.Cold Pack! --> This is a Special Addon if you want more cool shit.Fever Pack! --> This is a Special Addon if you want more cool shit.Impossible Pack! --> Let's see how tough you really are... This will also show you a REAL TRUE ENDING but you just need to know how... >:)WinMario Version --> Welcome to the Alternate Universe! This took place after BF and GF says goodbye to WinMario for Final Time (Week 16). and then They Left, and WinMario have an idea, he decides to get the tools ready so he can build the dangerous device ever, which is the Time Machine, and the reason why he is building the time machine it's because he wants to prevent himself from going through the Hell of the Portals including... Mr. Glitch. And that's how WinMario meets WinMario. lolBF Version --> Boyfriend is now on his own, Nobody can help him (except GF)(and this is a Part 2 to WinMario Version.)Pico Version --> In the alternate universe... well... Instead of BF & GF breaks in, it was Pico & Nene. Well, this is where it is about to get random.GF Version --> GF was having dream about where BF have went on a Vacation with his Family and he won't be back until New Years. And after that. GF felt alone so she went everywhere to fight someone with singing skills but she stands upon to WinMario, and for odd reason, WinMario didn't hesitate and does it anyway. But remember... It was just a DREAM. and yes it's also took place after Week 16 but it might be possibly Canon because of her dream while she was asleep. There is no dialogue or cutscene for this because I am lazy. and I got better stuff to do. so... use your imagination about what is going on=====================================================-☆- Q&A -☆-=====================================================1. Can you port this to V-Slice?Nope, too hard.2. If it's too hard, can you make it easier?It depends.3. Does your Mod share the same story with FNF Pibby Corrupted?HELL NO4. What's your Birthday?August 28, 20105. What's the oldest version you ever released?Alpha Version as a Physical but on Source Code's release, it's Pre-Alpha (0.0.0.1 or 0.0.0)6. What Engine do you use? In case it's Psych, what version?P-Slice (1.0.4 edition)7. What’s your favorite version of Psych Version?0.7.3 & 1.0.48. What’s your least favorite version of Psych Version?0.6.39. Can you port this to P-Slice?:/ duh.10. Can you turn this to Psych Version 0.6.3?HELL NO11. Can you add Mobile Support?If it's possible.12. Since you add 2 people on Weeks 10 & 11, can I be in your mod?No, but you can Mod it.13. Can you port this to Codename Engine?HELL NO14. You're a Windows User, How do you Manage to Compile Linux & Mac?MacOS -> I used VMwareLinux -> I previously used Virtual Box and now I used Windows Subsystem for Linux.15. Where can I report if there is a bug?On Github16. What Codes Did you use to make or edit this?10% Lua, 90% Haxe17. I can use this as a FNF Engine?Sure! Want to use a Mod Pack? Go ahead! Want to use it as a Source Mod, You’re free to do so. At least I credited almost everyone.18. Why is the Latest Version of Vs. WinMario is not in Gamebanana?It is here as for the Archives of v1.5.2 & under if somebody wants to explore the history of WinMario. But for the latest version, it was not there because Gamebanana’s Maximum Game Size is 1.2 GB and the mod is 1.5 or 2 GB. And besides, Game Jolt is better because their rules are not strict & unfair unlike the Gamebanana, like hell, I made the Vs. WinMario Legacy on Gamebanana and they took it down as duplication, and when I re-release on Game Jolt, they didn’t!19. Why is Vs. WinMario Source Code is not on Github?Originally, Github locked my own account, but right now, they finally let me in, but the reason why I still refused to upload them on GitHub is because of the File Limitations towards Assets and the Game too.20. How did you add a Desktop State? It Looks Cool! With Lua Code too!Sadly, you need to learn how to code & use Haxe.=====================================================-☆- Read the Warnings. -☆-=====================================================Please don't get confused with Other Super Mario Mods, Because of the title.If MacOS user reading this, If the Game is refused to open due to "Apple's Strict Secruity" then please go to -> https://github.com/ShadowMario/FNF-PsychEngine/issues/15792 for Help.To put WinMario, Psych, or P-Slice Mod Packs, please Right Click the WinMario.app and click that says "Show Package Contents" and go to "Contents/Resources" and you can see the Mod Folders and you place the Mods there. If yall using MacOS 26 or more than that, I am not sure if Vs. WinMario Application Icon will load because of Liquid Glass thing.If Linux user reading this, Please open terminal, and Install VLC Libraries, otherwise, the game will not open.If everyone reading this, please remember that V3 or later that Splits "scripts" folder to "luaScript" (Lua only) & "haxeScript" (Haxe/HX Script). so look inside the Psych/P-Slice Mod Pack (because it has "scripts" folder, so if the Filename is lua "script.lua" put it under "luaScript" folder but if it's haxe "script.hx" put it under "haxeScript" folder.Yes. Vs. WinMario is indeed a FNF Cover Song, but at least I credited "almost" Everyone. But please let me know if I missing somebody. But again, Full Credits are in the game.The Reason why it loads for very long time on the Gamebanana Page for Vs. WinMario is because of credits. But for the last time, I credited ALMOST everyone, so I appreciate for your wait, or Find alternatives like Game Jolt for faster loading. (My mod will get trashed If I don't credit everyone on this Gamebanana Site. ;( )Help Wanted for porting Mobile is now active but if you're gonna do that, then please do these first,1. I put the Link for the Source Code (USE THE LATEST VERSION NOT THE OLD VERSIONS)2. Please remove the Custom Notetype called "Error" that is only used for PCs.3. If you are porting to iOS, please exclude any Lua or Haxe Scripts that has a function to close the Game, otherwise, Apple will bricked My mod.4. If you are done, contact me on Instagram or Discord, if not then send a comment on Gamebanana or Game Jolt.You have every right to port this to different engine if it's not possible.===================================================== -☆- ENJOY THE GAME!!! -☆-=====================================================

mods.description: This is a Psych Engine port of the first challenge in FNF ONLINE VS, the Hank Challenge (with the song's name being "Accelerant").This port is intended to be used with the ONLINE VS. Result Screen Port.A lot of people have already tried to port this challenge to psych, but most of these ports are rushed, inaccurate, and just stupidly lazy (written before TheConcealedCow made his port, which is very good as well and is definitly worth your time). In this port, however, I tried to put as much effort as I can and I wanted this port to be one of the best psych engine ports to date. I hope you'll enjoy this port as much as I enjoyed making it!Accelerant REDUXThe offical remix (by philiplol) for Accelerant, "Accelerant REDUX", is playable in this port as an unlockable song. This was originally supposed to only be a preview for a full Accelerant REDUX mod, which would have had completely new visuals, animations and cutscenes, a "normal" difficulty and a few new mechanics, but I completely canceled it.Read the README.md file from this mod's folder if you're looking for more information about this port and the plans I have for its future

mods.description: WHERE THE EVIL LIVES IN"This mod might have some spoilers regarding some works so make sure to check them out!"WHERE THE EVIL LIVES IN is a FNF mod created by KillLa蓮 & Frosttim3r it consists of a compilation of one-shot songs featuring characters from any horror media such as: movies, series, games and stories.Lore (ignore if u want lol):"Years have passed after the events of FNF and BF and GF have finally stayed together, But nothing lasts forever. On a mysterious night, the sky turned red, innocent screams rang out, eyes turned away, and knees buckled as a chaotic, bloodthirsty figure descended from the heavens—the one who proclaimed himself the God of this world. The earth split in two, buildings crumbled, taking the lives of many. BF could do nothing but flee, but that entity had different plans for everyone there. In the blink of an eye, GF had her guts brutally ripped out, BF's eyes widened, his heart stopped instantly as the corpse of his beloved fell at his feet while blood poured from the sky and flooded the city. At that moment, no one was safe, And then, everything went dark, and nothing remained but the rotting carcasses of innocent corpses. BF therefore awakens in a parallel world, where there is nothing, only a dark and lifeless void, alone, trapped and confused. A disconcerting and demonic voice sounds in his ears, words like: "FEEL," "SEE," and "PRAY." It seemed like a dream. BF wanted to believe it was a dream, to see his beloved brutally murdered before his eyes. It didn't seem real. BF kneels, tears streaming down his face, his neutral expression turning to mourning. "NO! WHAT THE FUCK IS THIS?!" BF exclaims, "THERE IS NOTHING TO FEAR." The same voice echoes in his head. "THIS IS SALVATION. YOUR LIVES AND BROKEN BODIES, SO SMALL, ARE NO LONGER IMPORTANT. NO ONE IS MORE IMPORTANT." The voice speaks, "I DON'T CARE, I'M GOING TO KILL YOU, YOU SON OF A BITCH! WHOEVER YOU ARE!" BF shouts, "THEN WE'LL SEE, DO WHAT YOU DO BEST, AND I'LL MIGHT HAVE OTHER PLANS FOR YOU, SO DON'T DIE!" the voice exclaims back. BF stands up, wipes away his tears, maintains a firm and strong posture."TAKE IT!" the voice calls back as a microphone emerges from the floor. BF picks it up and looks at it with a mocking and confident expression, "HA! You must have shit in your mind, I'm going to rip your dick off and make you swallow it back!" The voice doesn't respond back, "HMPH! Asshole..." BF whispers as he walks towards what looks like a bright light, and as he approaches he encounters his first opponent. From then on, BF will finally discover that there is no goodness there, and that EVIL WILL LIVE WITH HIM NO MATTER WHERE HE IS"Mod includes:- 5 Songs (for now)- Revamped Title Screen- Death Voice lines for each character- Cool visuals- Unlockable Trophies- Banger songs- Custom death screen- Blessed by ZalgoThere are many creepy opponents to come! mods.title: VS IMPOSTOR: LEGACY
mods.description: VS IMPOSTOR IS BACK!A from-the-ground-up remaster of the 2023 mod, VS IMPOSTOR V4! VS IMPOSTOR: LEGACY intends to be faithful to the original experience, while introducing new tweaks and features to make it the definitive version of the mod you know and love!VS IMPOSTOR is a total-conversion mod for Friday Night Funkin', in which you face off against colorful Among Us characters. With over 10 weeks and 57 songs! this mod has plenty of content for you to explore, especially with brand-new awards and cosmetics for you to find and collect! And who knows? maybe there are more secrets to discover...OPTIMIZATIONTHE MOD IS ACTUALLY OPTIMIZED NOW... here's a little comparison of Danger alone... although in the real v4 nothing ever unloaded from your memory so by the time you'd get to danger on a fresh playthrough it'd probably be more like 4gigsLANGUAGEThis time around, the mod's not only in English! We've brought members of the community together and have translated the mod into 28 languages!EXPANDED COSMICUBE!Legacy's Cosmicube has been heavily expanded compared to the original from 2023. With tons of new skins and pets to find, you'll have a lot more to find and discover!AWARDSThere are 28 new awards for you to unlock! Will you get them all?BRAND-NEW DLC!With 5 new songs, and an entirely new Cosmicube, the SECURITY DLC will be made available when Legacy launches on April 25th!To install, just drag and drop the "securitydlc" folder into the content folderStill need help? Follow our video guide!MODDINGWanna make your own cosmicube? Add your own week or songs! Check out the official modding doc!

mods.title: V.S. Whitty Full Week (LEGACY)
mods.description: While strolling with your Girlfriend though an alleyway, you happen to notice an ominous glow coming from around the corner. Out steps Whitmore (Whitty), a hot-headed rock star who happens to have some beef with your Girlfriends parents. Think you've got what it takes to get him outta there?Base game changes:VS Whitty adds a new input system, which is based off other rhythm games like etterna/quaver.VS Whitty also changes the default WASD keybinds to DFJK.Please go and support the artist and composer of the music here: https://www.instagram.com/sock.clip/Support Kade, who coded all the hard stuff here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fzy2mi1CxKwListen to the soundtrack here: https://soundcloud.com/sock-wav/sets/back-alley-blitz-vs-whitty-fnf-mod-pack

mods.title: Friday Night Funkin': Doki Doki Takeover Plus!
mods.description: After a year's worth of work, the final update to Friday Night Funkin' Doki Doki Takeover is here! Presenting, Doki Doki Takeover Plus!The FNF and DDLC worlds have entangled, causing unusual things to occur when Monika finds herself in the Hating Sim and when Boyfriend and Girlfriend wind up in the Literature Club. How shall things fare for these three and the rest of the club?This mod includes:>30+ Songs featuring all your favorite Literature Club members!>A full fledged story spanning across several weeks!>40+ Costumes for each character!>Lots of secret content to discover!
